# DSH Session Kanban
**English** | 简体中文

Documentation Wiki ·
Releases ·
Issues

A session kanban board plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It adds a board to the DSH
Web UI side

bar where every chat session's current work, todo progress, running state and
recent activity are vi

sible at a glance — click any card to jump straight back into that
session.
## Screenshots
_Overview page._
## Features

- **Sidebar entry** — a panel icon next to the built-in panels opens the kanban board.
- **Overview

home** — session totals, running count, todo completion and a GitHub-style
activity heatmap with yea

r / month / week / day scales, plus workday/non-workday
highlighting for the selected country.
- **S

ession cards** — current request and latest reply, todo progress bar, updated time,
working director

y, running state; click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open the session.
- **Quick actions** — pin

/ unpin, inline rename, fork, copy Session ID, archive (with
confirmation), refresh and new session

. Sessions owned by subagent routing cannot be
renamed: the action is disabled and hovering it expla

ins why. Archiving the Session
currently held by the main view reopens the board afterwards instead

of leaving the user
on the new-session home.
- **Tabs and search** — Overview / All / Running / With

-todos / Completed, plus a search
box that filters both the board and the overview aggregates. The t

hree content tabs
partition every visible session: Completed is the catch-all for sessions with no
u

nfinished todos (fully done, no todo list, or details not loaded yet), so nothing is
left only in Al

l.
- **Session relationships** — subagent and team-member child sessions show a compact row
naming t

he relation and linking to their parent; parent cards count the child sessions
visible in the curren

t view. One family shares one accent colour (parent and children have
the same tinted left edge and

relation dots), so scattered masonry cards can be matched to
their parent regardless of order. Forke

d sessions are independent top-level sessions (the
source is only fork provenance), so they are neit

her shown as children nor counted; an
archived parent keeps its title with an “archived” marker inst

ead of a dead “not visible”
link.
- **Filters** — the Agent Team scope (when teams exist) and a Work

space filter (defaults
to **All workspaces**, hidden when the host has only one Workspace, persisted

across
reloads) combine with the tabs and search. Sessions the host does not account to a
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0` with the Web UI and plugin support.
The range i

s declared as `engines.dsh` in `package.json` and shown by the DSH plugin
market; development and te

sting ran on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`–`0.2.1-rc.5` (desktop profile).
- The package is ESM (`"type": "module

"`) and loads `react` from the running DSH host, so
no runtime dependency is bundled.
- `node` + `pn
pm` are only needed for the offline tests.

## Usage

1. Open the board from the **Session Kanban** panel icon in the left sidebar.
2. **Overview** shows

the totals, todo completion and the activity heatmap; switch the
heatmap scale with **Year / Month /

Week / Day** and, in Settings, the workday calendar
country.
3. Switch to **All** for the masonry c

ard list; each card shows the session's current work,
latest reply, todo list, working directory and

updated time.
4. **Click** a card to jump back into that session. Hover the card footer for pin, re

name,
fork, copy Session ID and archive actions.
5. Narrow the list with the tab filters, the Agent

Team scope, the Workspace filter and the
search box — all filters combine.
6. The heatmap sidebar ke

eps a compact status row: refresh icon · country · last refresh
date (`YYYY/MM/DD`) · data source, e

.g. `↻ China · 2026/10/26 · Holiday CN`. Hover it for
the full status and workday rule; click the re
fresh icon to update immediately.
## How it works
Two halves ship in one bundle:

- **`index.js`** — host half. Registers the `sessionKanban` session projection, folding
`user/messag

e`, `assistant/message`, `turn/start`, `turn/end` and `todo/write` into
`{ request, reply, turn, end

Kind, todos, done, inProgress, total }`, so cards render
without replaying session logs.
- **`client

.js`** — client half. Registers the sidebar entry (`sidebar.panellist`), the
board panel (`main`) an

d the General-settings rows (`settings.general.item`), then
renders the board with React based on th

e host `Menu` / `Tooltip` / `Button` primitives.
- **`cordis.patch.yml`** — bundle patch that insert
s the plugin row into the profile.
## Privacy

- Requests are made by the browser only, to the public endpoints listed above.
- Results are cached

in `localStorage`; no credentials, session contents or personal data
are sent.
- The plugin adds no

torage`; no credentials, session contents or personal data
are sent.
- The plugin adds no telemetry.
## Limitations

- Holiday data is **national-level only**. Countries whose states/provinces differ
(Germany, Canada,

Australia, Spain, Switzerland, …) would need a subdivision selector,
which is not implemented yet.

- Nager.Date currently has no dataset for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Thailand, Malaysia
or India

, so those calendars fall back to the weekend rule only until a dedicated source
is added.
- This is
a local/experimental plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.
